title: Emergency BREAK
description: Use BREAK statement to exit WHILE loop early when critical condition is met.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "The ship is scanning for safe landing zones. We'll check up to 10 zones, but if we find one that's 'safe', we should stop immediately. That's what BREAK is for."
story.context: BREAK allows you to exit a loop early, before the main condition becomes false. It's essential for efficiency—why keep looping if you've already found what you need?
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Perfect! You found the safe zone at position 4 and stopped immediately. BREAK saved us 6 unnecessary checks. In real automation, this saves time and resources."

instructions: Create list ${zones} with values: dangerous, dangerous, dangerous, safe, dangerous, dangerous
- IF ${status} equals 'safe', log 'Safe zone found!' and BREAK
hints: Create List: @{zones}=    Create List    dangerous    dangerous    dangerous    safe    ...
No END needed after BREAK (it's a single statement)
solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Landing Zone Scan
    ${zone}=    Set Variable    1
    @{zones}=    Create List    dangerous    dangerous    dangerous    safe    dangerous    dangerous
    WHILE    ${zone} <= 10
        ${status}=    Set Variable    ${zones}[${zone - 1}]
        Log    Zone ${zone}: ${status}
        IF    '${status}' == 'safe'
            Log    Safe zone found!
            BREAK
        END
        ${zone}=    Set Variable    ${zone + 1}
    END
    Log    Scan complete

theory.title: Exercise 3.1.4: BREAK Statement
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "Why waste energy checking all 10 zones if we find a safe one at zone 4? BREAK lets us exit immediately."

BREAK Statement

BREAK immediately exits the current loop, regardless of the loop condition:

WHILE    ${condition}
    IF    ${exit_condition}
        BREAK
    END
    # More code...
END

When to Use BREAK:

  • Found what you're looking for (search successful)
  • Critical error occurred (stop processing)
  • Resource limit reached (max attempts)
  • Early exit improves performance

Example: Search with BREAK

WHILE    ${index} < ${max_items}
    ${item}=    Get Item    ${index}
    IF    '${item}' == '${target}'
        Log    Found at position ${index}!
        BREAK
    END
    ${index}=    Set Variable    ${index + 1}
END

⚠️ BREAK Rules

  • Only works inside loops (WHILE, FOR)
  • Exits the innermost loop only (if nested)
  • Code after BREAK in loop is skipped
  • No END needed for BREAK itself
